result_text:
`analyzeLandscape` is now an alias of `updateLandscape`. The `cli` module compiles. I didn't run any tests or try either command, including `-help`.

- **Dispatch:** `CommandLineInterface.java` now sends both names to the same `updateLandscape` method, so they take the same options. `-help` prints the usage of whichever name was typed. `analyzeLandscape` shows the description you asked for (landscape counterpart of the analysis commands, same as `updateLandscape`).
- **Constants and overview:** `Commands.java` has new `ANALYZE_LANDSCAPE` and `ANALYZE_LANDSCAPE_DESCRIPTION` constants. `analyzeLandscape` is listed in the no-argument usage overview, just before `updateLandscape`.
- **README:** It had no command descriptions, so I added a short "Landscape command" section. It documents `analyzeLandscape -analysisRoot <folder>` and notes that `updateLandscape` is the older name and still works.
